threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'the underground'. It’s a dead giveaway, especially when you ask for the nearest station.
Saw a guy on the N133 last night arguing with a streetlight, convinced it was blinking back at him. Brixton after dark is something else.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a group of kids skateboarding on the roof of an abandoned building at Sonnenallee—where else but Neukölln would that happen?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find street performers in U-Bahn stations, mixing art and transit in a way that turns daily commutes into mini-concerts.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they know to avoid BART on Fridays after 5PM—nothing says ‘tourist’ like a confused look during a train delay.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy on the 5 Fulton trying to debate the moon landing with an EMT. The bus rolled up right as he yelled, 'I swear it was all green screens!'

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the Gaudí sights, but the real charm is in the corner bakeries where grandmas still make pastries.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they order a ‘café con leche’—most locals skip the extra milk and just go for a ‘café’.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for directions and someone tells you to take the back alleys. Not a single street name is mentioned.
Heard a guy on the 59 last night ranting about how he’s never seen a rat in a tuxedo before. Brixton on a Saturday, I guess!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The unmistakable scent of grilled kebabs wafting from the corner stand while your neighbor’s cat makes itself at home on your balcony.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a tram stop where buskers compete for your attention while you wait for your ride—real Berlin multitasking.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate the BART outages; a tourist waits cluelessly while we just sigh and pull out our phones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today packed so tight, a guy in a tuxedo was sandwiched between a street performer and a dog with a sweater. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists assume every bar serves tapas. In Gràcia, you'll find more craft cocktails than patatas bravas if you know where to look.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones asking for directions to La Sagrada Família while holding a paper map, oblivious to the metro stops nearby.
